rationale: B commits to an art direction made for this brief: ruled ledger paper in sage and cream, heavy condensed headlines, folio numbering, a live journal table in the hero and a red 'ZERO' that carries through to the 0.00 trial balance, control register and full-bleed red sign-up band. A is a well-finished but familiar dark SaaS template (lime accent, italic serif emphasis, glass cards, giant footer wordmark) whose first viewport stays essentially empty until about 1.3 s and whose scroll frames at 675 px, 2025 px and 8100 px leave large dead areas. B's headline resolves line by line within about 850 ms, and its scroll shows more varied storytelling (pinned request/entries/settled ledger steps, word-by-word text highlight in security, horizontal customer slips, section colour changes) against A's single strong pinned payment-flow diagram. Hover feedback is clear on both (A: nav pill and button glow; B: underlines and a dark-to-red button flip) and both phone layouts hold up without clipping.
